nasalization_rules.description: Stops [ㄱ, ㄷ, ㅂ] assimilate to nasals [ㅇ, ㄴ, ㅁ] before nasals [ㄴ, ㅁ]

tensification_rules.description: Lax consonants become tense after unreleased stops

liquidization_rules.description: ㄴ and ㄹ assimilate to double lateral ㄹㄹ

palatalization_rules.description: ㄷ, ㅌ before /i/ become ㅈ, ㅊ

aspiration_rules.description: Lax stop + ㅎ (or ㅎ + lax stop) merge to aspirated stop
